newsitem.title: USA: Clayton names Stegmayer as vice chairman.
newsitem.headline: Clayton names Stegmayer as vice chairman.

text.p: Clayton Homes Inc said Monday it named Joe Stegmayer vice-chairman and chairman of the executive committee.
The company said Stegmayer, who was president, will focus on strategic planning, acquisitions, alliances, and group synergies.
It also named Kevin Clayton, president of the financial services unit, to replace Stegmayer as company president. He will continue to concentrate on financial services and related new products.
Also, John Kalec, who is chief financial officer, was given the additional title of senior vice president.
The executive committee will consist of Jim Clayton, chairman and chief executive; Joe Stegmayer; Kevin Clayton; and David Booth, who is executive vice president.
